title: I love this table cloth
text: I love this table cloth. I love this table cloth. I have purchased many tablecloths that weren't cotton and I couldn't keep them on the table.  They would slide all over the place.  We nearly had a terrible accident for Christmas.  It's cotton for me from now on, and this is not only soft and absorbent, but a nice, non-overbearing pattern and color.
